objectives.goal: Enumerate the transient runtime workspace artifacts (backups, archives, stale generated files) under runtime/ that are untracked and not required for reproducibility.
done_when: A deterministic scan lists every candidate path under runtime/ that is safe to remove.

objectives.goal: Confirm each candidate is covered by the governance backup/archive .gitignore policy so removal preserves all evidence.
done_when: Every candidate is either git-ignored or already archived; no tracked or required artifact is listed.

objectives.goal: Produce evidence of the cleaned workspace state without deleting any tracked or required artifact.
